en: Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large concrete arch bridge crossing a frozen or snow‑covered river or inlet. Sparse leafless trees stand in the foreground, with snow‑covered houses and dense coniferous forest on the right hillside. The bridge has a prominent central arch carrying a long viaduct of evenly spaced vertical supports. A small circular publisher logo appears in the lower right corner, reinforcing the postcard format.
